As government goes home and this question will be put despite our protestations, I ask the government members to think about that. To think about the ways in which all of the dispirit things in the Financial Measures (2026) Act, all of the things that we've been discussing in the last days and weeks, are connected, and to take the care that is required, and to do the work that is required to make sure that when you pull on one string, things don't unravel.

We know hard choices need to be made. We can disagree on whether we needed to get to where we are. I don't think we did, but here we are. I would say that our biggest message is to proceed with care, proceed with caution. Sectors will be impacted, jobs will be lost, families will be affected.

We oppose the question being put and we humbly request that this government do the work to ensure that this budget serves Nova Scotians and comes back with something that we can support. Thank you, Speaker.
